abstract: >
  Per-sample count-range sanity checks applied after `transform_assay`.
  Three binary flags are evaluated for each sample: maximum count < 10,
  minimum count < 0, and majority of non-zero counts being non-integer.
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    message: false
    warning: false
    echo: false
params:
  sanity_check_tbl: "NA"

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(DT)
library(targets)

#sanity_check_tbl <- params[1]$sanity_check_tbl
sanity_check_tbl <- tar_read(sanity_checked_sample_stats_combined, store = "/vast/scratch/users/shen.m/cellNexus/2024-07-01/process_updated_samples_transform_hpcell_target_store_v1"
                     )

sanity_check_cols <- c("sanity_check_max_lt_10", "sanity_check_min_lt_0", "sanity_check_rounding_error")

sanity_check_labels <- c(
  sanity_check_max_lt_10      = "Maximum count < 10",
  sanity_check_min_lt_0       = "Minimum count < 0",
  sanity_check_rounding_error = "Rounding error (<1e-4)"
)
```

## Overview

```{r summary-table}
n_total <- nrow(sanity_check_tbl)

sanity_check_tbl |>
  summarise(across(all_of(sanity_check_cols), sum)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "flag", values_to = "n_flagged") |>
  mutate(
    Flag          = recode(flag, !!!sanity_check_labels),
    `Flagged (n)` = n_flagged,
    `Clean (n)`   = n_total - n_flagged
  ) |>
  select(Flag, `Flagged (n)`, `Clean (n)`) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", ordering = TRUE))
```

## Flag Counts per Category

How many samples carry each individual flag.

```{r flag-bar, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
sanity_check_tbl |>
  summarise(across(all_of(sanity_check_cols), sum)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "flag", values_to = "n_flagged") |>
  mutate(flag = recode(flag, !!!sanity_check_labels)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(flag, -n_flagged), y = n_flagged, fill = flag)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_flagged), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of samples", title = "Samples flagged per check") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
```

## Flag Co-occurrence

Number of flags carried simultaneously per sample.

```{r flag-combo, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
sanity_check_tbl |>
  mutate(n_flags = rowSums(across(all_of(sanity_check_cols)))) |>
  count(n_flags) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(n_flags), y = n, fill = factor(n_flags))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  labs(x = "Number of flags", y = "Number of samples",
       title = "Flag co-occurrence") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Flagged Sample Detail

Full table of all samples that carry at least one flag.

```{r flagged-detail}
flagged <- sanity_check_tbl |>
  filter(if_any(all_of(sanity_check_cols), ~ . == 1L)) |>
  rename(
    "Maximum_count < 10"            = sanity_check_max_lt_10,
    "Minimum_count < 0"             = sanity_check_min_lt_0,
    "Rounding error"      = sanity_check_rounding_error
  )

if (nrow(flagged) == 0) {
  cat("No samples were flagged.")
} else {
  DT::datatable(flagged, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
}
```

sanity_check_tbl |>
